title: Former soldier sees triangle take off at Area 51

tellings.quote: weirdly enough, I've talked to a guy who former uh army in the the mid 2010s who said he saw a a like a triangle craft jut off of an airway in Area 51.

plain: A UFO researcher who goes by the online name UAPGerb said on a podcast hosted by Jesse Michels that he once talked with a former Army man who served in the mid 2010s. According to that man, he saw a triangle-shaped craft shoot off an airstrip at Area 51, a secretive US military test site in the Nevada desert. If true, it would mean unusual craft are being flown, or kept, at the base.
